evidence.excerpt: We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects.
